variants.title: Introduce the idea
variants.rationale: Lead with a concise promise and a preview.
variants.tradeoff: Detailed proof appears later.

variants.title: Show the outcome
variants.rationale: Give the finished output the largest visual role.
variants.tradeoff: Visitors see less explanation above the fold.

variants.title: Begin with the process
variants.rationale: Use a guided sequence before the invitation.
variants.tradeoff: The primary action is reached later.

intent.outcome: Give visitors enough orientation to decide whether to explore further.
intent.uncertainty: Does explanation, visible output, or a guided starting point best support that decision?
intent.evidence: Can the reviewer identify the purpose and a relevant next action without guessing?

variants.title: Compare plans
variants.rationale: Place plan differences near the top.
variants.tradeoff: The page assumes visitors understand the product.

variants.title: Explain then choose
variants.rationale: Establish the use case before presenting plans.
variants.tradeoff: Comparison takes another scroll.

variants.title: Guide the decision
variants.rationale: Present a starting question with plan recommendations.
variants.tradeoff: Experienced buyers may prefer a direct table.

variants.title: Compact links
variants.rationale: Keep navigation in one horizontal row.
variants.tradeoff: Space for secondary destinations is limited.

Sample service

intent.outcome: Help a first-time visitor decide whether this fictional service fits their task and identify a sensible next step.
intent.means: Examples of output, an explanation of the service, and comparable plan information.
intent.constraints: Sample content only. No real product claims, purchase flow, or account creation.
intent.uncertainty: We have not established which information visitors need before evaluating plans.
intent.evidence: Ask reviewers to explain who the service helps and what they would do next. Conversion impact needs later behavioral evidence.
